description: This file implements the DistAutogradContainer class for managing distributed autograd contexts in PyTorch, including context creation, retrieval, release, and RPC communication.

classes.name: DistAutogradContainer
classes.description: Manages distributed autograd contexts, including creation, retrieval, release, and communication with other workers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with a worker ID, setting context ID and message ID ranges.

methods.name: computeNumShards
methods.description: Computes the number of shards based on hardware concurrency, ensuring it is a power of two.

methods.name: getShard
methods.description: Retrieves the shard corresponding to a given context ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the container, ensuring it is initialized.

methods.name: getInstanceInternal
methods.description: Creates or returns the static singleton instance of the container.

methods.name: newAutogradMessageId
methods.description: Generates a new autograd message ID, ensuring no overflow.

methods.name: getOrCreateContext
methods.description: Retrieves an existing context by ID or creates a new one.

methods.name: getWorkerId
methods.description: Returns the worker ID associated with this container.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new autograd context, assigning a new context ID.

methods.name: hasValidContext
methods.description: Checks if the current thread has a valid autograd context.

methods.name: currentContext
methods.description: Returns the current thread's autograd context.

methods.name: releaseContextIfPresent
methods.description: Releases a context if it exists, and sends a cleanup RPC.

methods.name: releaseContext
methods.description: Releases a context and sends a cleanup RPC.

methods.name: sendReleaseContextRpc
methods.description: Sends an RPC to other workers to release a context.

methods.name: eraseContextIdAndReset
methods.description: Erases a context ID from a shard and resets thread-local context if needed.

methods.name: isValidContext
methods.description: Checks if a context ID is valid.

methods.name: retrieveContext
methods.description: Retrieves a context by ID.

methods.name: getMaxId
methods.description: Returns the maximum context ID.

methods.name: forceCurrentContextId
methods.description: Forcibly sets the current thread's context ID.

methods.name: setCurrentContextId
methods.description: Sets the current thread's context ID, asserting it was invalid before.

methods.name: clearCurrentContext
methods.description: Clears the current thread's context ID.

methods.name: numAutogradContexts
methods.description: Returns the total number of autograd contexts.

methods.name: currentContextId
methods.description: Returns the current thread's context ID.
